cv.name: Narek Kolyan
cv.principle3: Prefer simple architectures over complex abstractions
cv.bio: Senior Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications. Focused on React, TypeScript, architecture, and performance. Open to remote opportunities.
cv.professionalSummaryText: Senior Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend architectures. Specialized in headless e-commerce, GraphQL data layers, and performance optimization for high-traffic applications. Experienced in modular UI systems, React Native, and delivering maintainable, scalable products.

cv.achievement2: Implemented GraphQL data layers and optimized data fetching for complex product and analytics UIs
cv.achievement3: Built headless Shopify storefronts and custom checkout flows for large-scale e-commerce
cv.achievement4: Developed AI-powered media generation workflows integrating multiple APIs and async processing
cv.achievement5: Shipped cross-platform React Native apps with BLE, health integrations, and OTA updates
cv.achievement6: Migrated state management to scalable solutions and improved UI performance across dashboards

accounting-platform.description: My first project - still in use today. Multi-language web application for accounting services in Armenia. Features canvas forms and form-to-email functionality. Built with modern React stack.

crypto-admin-panel.description: Admin panel for cryptocurrency exchange and statistics. Built for a Ukrainian company. Real-time pair tickers, account capital charts, trading tables, and role-based admin navigation.
crypto-admin-panel.feature2: Account capital and P&L analytics with area charts
crypto-admin-panel.feature3: Trading pairs and assets doughnut breakdowns

nft-whitelabel-platform.description: White-label NFT marketplace front-end. Pack drops, collections, redeem flows, wallet connect, and Redux Toolkit entity architecture with Storybook.
nft-whitelabel-platform.feature1: White-label NFT marketplace with themed color packs
nft-whitelabel-platform.feature2: Pack carousel, collection filters, and redeem flows
nft-whitelabel-platform.feature3: Wallet connect and shopping cart integration
nft-whitelabel-platform.feature4: Entity-driven Redux architecture with mock/API injection
nft-whitelabel-platform.feature6: Responsive layouts with Poppins design system

mobile-ecommerce-solution.description: Ready-to-use mobile shopping apps for 100+ brands across Russia, UK, and US. 5+ analytics variants, custom backend, Shopify integration. Fullstack role (React, React Native, Node.js) in 40+ team.

rv-rental-platform.description: Built headless Shopify storefront serving thousands of products with optimized GraphQL queries and scalable UI architecture. US-based RV rental platform with custom checkout and campground booking. Worked as React developer on multiple rental projects.

ai-social-media-generator.description: AI studio for social content. Multi-model image/video generation, scene-based stitching, brand guidelines, and automated prompt pipelines. Built for US client.

git-cli-tool.description: use-multiple-gits — CLI to manage multiple git identities (user.name, user.email, SSH keys). One-command setup, use-work / use-personal switching, shell integration. MIT · npm.

dealer-service-portal.description: Nx monorepo for cabinetry manufacturing — admin analytics, dealer accounts, quote workflows, and role-based portals for internal staff and dealer partners.
dealer-service-portal.feature1: Admin analytics with period filters (7d / 30d / 90d / YTD)
dealer-service-portal.feature2: Dealer account management and status workflows
dealer-service-portal.feature3: Role-based admin and dealer client apps
dealer-service-portal.feature4: Quote pipeline KPIs and dealer rankings
dealer-service-portal.feature5: Organizations and users tables with live filtering

service-admin-panel.description: Enterprise admin dashboard for 50+ employee company. User segmentation, marketing campaigns, real-time analytics. HubSpot and Communication Service integrations.

mobile-webview-app.description: React Native application with WebView integration for displaying company website. Main feature is per-app VPN functionality that users can enable directly in the app. Built for previous company.

mobile-health-device-app.description: Cross-platform mobile app for connected smart devices and health data. BLE device pairing, OTA firmware updates, and sync with major health platforms. React Native with TypeScript and Expo.
mobile-health-device-app.feature3: Health platform sync (iOS HealthKit, Android Health Connect, Google Fit)

armapply-telegram-bot.description: Telegram-first AI job hunter. Upload a CV once, discover jobs daily, score fit with an LLM, and create grounded Gmail drafts with one tap — sent from the user's own account.

armapply-telegram-bot.feature2: Daily job discovery from LinkedIn, staff.am, and Telegram channels
armapply-telegram-bot.feature3: Fit scoring with grounded, experience-based cover letters
armapply-telegram-bot.feature4: One-tap Gmail draft creation with CV attached
armapply-telegram-bot.feature5: User-owned Gmail sending — no shared inbox spam
